data.long_meaning: Often derived from the Arabic root ع-ل-ي (ʿ-l-y), 'to be high, noble'. Its root is ع-ل-ي (ʿ-l-y). A modern Muslim given name. Alina is a Arabic name meaning “Noble; bright; beautiful”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.etymology: Often derived from the Arabic root ع-ل-ي (ʿ-l-y), 'to be high, noble'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alina total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
